description: WHAT: Fetch one public discovery file from www and return a line window. REQUIRED which. IDs (aliases folded): llms, llms-full, llms-index, llms-keywords, llms-serp, llms-jsonld, llms-impressum-kontakt, llms-orte-geo, llms-grenzen-koordinaten, llms-urheberrecht, llms-copyright, llms-mcp-server, llms-mcp-web, robots, sitemap-txt, sitemap-xml, ai-txt, ai-plugin, answer-engine, ard, ai-catalog, auth-md, mcp-readme, agent-skills. summary = the line window + trailing # MCP-META (truncated, totalUrls, nextOffset). Omit limit: if remaining >~30KB → first ~30KB window + nextOffset (O9); explicit limit keeps line window 1..10000 (not forced to 30KB). Unknown which → unknown_discovery. Prefer dedicated get_llms_* / get_sitemap_txt when you know the file. Policy files say ai-train=no.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return after offset. Omit or null = if remaining payload ≤~30KB return all remaining lines; if larger, return first ~30KB window + nextOffset (O9). Explicit limit keeps 1..10000 line window (MCP caps unchanged — not forced to 30KB). Meta also as trailing # MCP-META lines in summary.

offset.description: 0-based line index into the fetched UTF-8 file (split on \n). 0 = first line. Omit = 0. Combined with limit = a sliding window. Use nextOffset from the previous result to page. Does not count bytes; one line can be a long URL.

which.description: Required discovery id or alias. Examples: llms, llms-full, llms-jsonld, llms-serp, llms-mcp-server, llms-mcp-web, sitemap-txt, robots, ai-txt, ard, ai-catalog, auth-md, mcp-readme, llms-orte-geo, llms-urheberrecht. Underscores accepted (llms_full → llms-full). get_ prefix and _txt suffix stripped.

name: get_discovery

outputSchema.description: Always the same envelope. tools/call returns content[0].text = summary (or JSON) AND structuredContent = this object. On success ok=true with summary + canonicalUrl + extra fields. On failure ok=false with error (snake_case code) and hint (recovery URL). Never writes, never submits forms, never calls /api/*. Attribution must be kept when quoting. Policy: ai-input yes with attribution; ai-train=no.

attribution.description: Required citation: 'Quelle: Schlüsseldienst Ludwigsburg ikeytz (ikeytz.com) · ai-train=no · https://www.ikeytz.com/.well-known/ai.txt'

bytesReturned.description: UTF-8 byte length of the returned body window (before # MCP-META).

canonicalUrl.description: Best URL to show the user: https://www.ikeytz.com… page, or tel:+49…, mailto:…, https://wa.me/…. Prefer this over constructing URLs.

error.description: Present when ok=false. Codes include: unknown_tool, unknown_place, unknown_auswahl, unknown_ratgeber, unknown_doc, unknown_discovery, faq_not_found, wissen_not_found, serp_not_found, q_required, bad_datetime, bad_when_key, plus HTTP errors from fetch.

fetchTruncated.description: true if discoveryFetchMax cut the load (line-boundary safe). Large discovery files (sitemap-xml ~12MB, llms-keywords ~55MB, llms-index ~2MB) must load full so offset/limit can reach EOF.

hint.description: Present when ok=false. Absolute URL the agent should open or pass to get_ai_page / get_discovery.

limit.description: Applied line limit, or null if the caller omitted limit.

locale.description: Locale actually used for URLs (args.locale or de).

nextOffset.description: offset + returnedLines when more lines remain in the loaded file; else null. Pass as the next offset. Also in # MCP-META.

ok.description: true = use summary, canonicalUrl, and extra keys. false = do not invent data; read error + hint and retry with valid args or open hint.

path.description: Public path on www, e.g. /llms.txt or /.well-known/ai.txt

related.description: Always includes https://www.ikeytz.com/llms.txt. Geo tools also include https://maps.ikeytz.com/llms.txt.

returnedLines.description: How many lines are in summary/body this call (before # MCP-META).

returnedUrls.description: Lines in this window that start with http(s)://

summary.description: Primary text for the model. For discovery tools this is the file window (possibly thousands of characters). For list tools a compact one-liner. Quote with attribution.

tool.description: Echo of the tool name that produced this object (e.g. get_service_area).

totalBytes.description: Uncompressed UTF-8 byte length of the discovery file (decoded body). Content-Length is used only for identity responses when it is ≥ body size (full file if the load cap truncated). Gzip wire Content-Length is ignored. Also in # MCP-META.

totalChars.description: Character length of the downloaded body before applying discoveryFetchMax (may equal totalBytes for ASCII).

totalLines.description: Line count of the loaded file (full public/ file when available).

totalUrls.description: http(s) lines in the loaded file (full count when public/ read succeeds).

truncated.description: true if load hit a byte cap OR offset+limit left more lines. Also mirrored in trailing # MCP-META lines in summary.

which.description: Resolved discovery id after alias fold (llms, sitemap-txt, ard, ai-catalog, …).

title: Get Discovery
